interface.name: treeland_output_manager_v1

description.summary: expose which is the primary display

interface.description: Protocol for telling which is the primary display among the selection of enabled outputs.

description.summary: Select which primary output to use
Get color control interface for output.

event.name: primary_output

description.summary: Provide the current primary output's name

event.description: Specifies which output is the primary one identified by their name.

interface.name: treeland_output_color_control_v1
interface.description: Protocol for controlling color temperature and brightness settings of a specific output.

request.name: set_color_temperature
request.description: Color temperature settings are applied only after a commit request is made. Setting a value outside the range [1000, 20000] is a protocol error.

request.name: set_brightness
request.description: Brightness settings are applied only after a commit request is made. Setting a value outside the range [0.0, 100.0] is a protocol error.

description.summary: Commit the pending color settings changes for output.
The result of the last commit request.

arg.name: success
arg.summary: 1 if the commit was successful, 0 otherwise.

event.name: color_temperature
event.description: Provides the current color temperature setting of the output. Color temperature is valued in the range [1000, 20000]. Color temperature is defined as the corresponding temperature (in Kelvin) of the current white point of the display on a Planckian locus. With the current implementation, the neutral temperature is 6600K. This event is sent once after the treeland_output_color_control_v1 object is created, or right after when a color temperature change for the output is successfully commited.

event.name: brightness
event.description: Provides the current brightness setting of the output. Brightness is valued in the range [0.0, 100.0]. This event is sent once after the treeland_output_color_control_v1 object is created, or right after when a brightness change for the output is successfully commited.
